# What Anthropic credentials the library redacts, and what it leaves alone.
#
# Every credential here is built from the ordered run 0123456789abcdef, which
# no real one is, written out until it is the ninety-five characters the pattern
# holds a body to. That count is a floor and not an abbreviation: unlike the
# runs the OpenAI cases stand in for, it cannot be shortened for readability
# without the case ceasing to hold a credential at all, which is why every
# line below is as long as a real one.
#
# The two cases under the over-match heading carry no ordered run in the place a
# body stands. They are no credential and nobody issued them: what they hold is a
# base64url blob carrying the prefix, a kind and a long enough run behind it,
# which is the whole of what the pattern asks for.

patterns: anthropic-credential

# The kinds of credential, which differ only in the name a kind writes between
# the prefix and the body. The pattern reads that there is a name rather than
# which one it is, so the Console key, the Admin API key, the two OAuth tokens
# issued for Claude Code, a session key of the documented version and of the
# version added beside it, and a kind nobody here has named are one shape in
# seven spellings.

case:     a console key in an environment assignment
in:       ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=«anthropic-credential»

case:     a console key in the header a request carries it in
in:       x-api-key: sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      x-api-key: «anthropic-credential»

case:     an admin api key
in:       sk-ant-admin01-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      «anthropic-credential»

case:     an oauth access token
in:       sk-ant-oat01-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      «anthropic-credential»

case:     an oauth refresh token
in:       sk-ant-ort01-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      «anthropic-credential»

case:     a session key of the documented version
in:       sk-ant-sid01-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      «anthropic-credential»

case:     a session key of the version added beside sid01
in:       sk-ant-sid02-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      «anthropic-credential»

case:     a key naming a kind this pattern was never told about
in:       sk-ant-zzz99-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      «anthropic-credential»

case:     a key in a client side configuration object
in:       {"apiKey":"sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde","model":"claude-opus-4"}
out:      {"apiKey":"«anthropic-credential»","model":"claude-opus-4"}

# The alphabet a body is written in. It is base64url, which is what both
# rulesets stating a shape admit behind the prefix: the letters of both cases,
# the digits, the hyphen and the underscore. The two characters standard base64
# writes in place of the last two, the plus and the slash, are not admitted, and
# neither is anything else — a character outside the alphabet ends the body
# where it stands, and what is left in front of it is too short to be one.

case:     a body carrying a hyphen and an underscore
in:       sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef-123456789abcdef_123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      «anthropic-credential»

case:     a plus in the body
in:       sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012+456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012+456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde

case:     a dot in the body
in:       sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012.456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012.456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde

case:     a character outside the alphabet at the first position of the body
in:       sk-ant-api03-+123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      sk-ant-api03-+123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde

# The kind, and the hyphen that closes it. The kind is one or more lowercase
# letters and digits, which is how every kind Anthropic has written spells
# itself, and the first hyphen behind the prefix is what divides it from a body
# that carries hyphens of its own. A run with no hyphen in it at all holds no
# kind to be divided from anything.

case:     an uppercase kind
in:       sk-ant-API03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      sk-ant-API03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde

case:     an underscore where the kind is closed by a hyphen
in:       sk-ant-api03_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      sk-ant-api03_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde

case:     no kind between the prefix and the body
in:       sk-ant-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      sk-ant-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde

# How long a body is, which is the one count this pattern reads. Ninety-five
# characters is what every published Anthropic credential carries and what both
# rulesets state, and it is read as a floor: a key longer than it is redacted to
# the end of its run, and a key shorter than it is not redacted at all. What the
# floor is doing besides stating the count is telling a credential from a
# hyphenated identifier, which is why it cannot simply be lowered — the last
# case in this file is the identifier it turns away.
#
# What that leaves over is the key cut short. A line cut to a column limit
# partway through one leaves a prefix, a kind and a body too short to be a body,
# and every random character written before the cut comes through in the clear.
# The two cases below are that, and they are here to be looked up rather than
# arrived at.

case:     a body one character longer than the floor
in:       sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdez
out:      «anthropic-credential»

case:     a key one character short of the floor
in:       ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcd
out:      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcd

case:     a key cut off at its kind
in:       ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-api03
out:      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-api03

case:     a body one character short of the floor, closed by a character outside the alphabet, with text after it
in:       sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcd next
out:      sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcd next

# What a key may be written against, and what it draws in. The prefix is the
# whole of the anchor and there is no boundary on either side of it, so a key
# keeps its span whatever word character stands in front of it. Behind it the
# redaction reaches to the end of the run, which is the price of reading a floor
# rather than a count: a character of the key's own alphabet written straight
# after a key is redacted with the key, and a space, a dot or a quote is not.

case:     a key after an underscore
in:       ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_«anthropic-credential»

case:     a key after a letter
in:       xsk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      x«anthropic-credential»

case:     a key at the end of a sentence
in:       the key is sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde.
out:      the key is «anthropic-credential».

case:     a key inside quotes
in:       export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde"
out:      export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="«anthropic-credential»"

case:     a key before a hyphenated word
in:       sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde-suffix
out:      «anthropic-credential»

case:     a key before a word
in:       sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdesuffix
out:      «anthropic-credential»

# Two keys written together. The prefix is written in the alphabet a body is, so
# a key can begin inside the span of the one before it; the two spans overlap
# and are redacted as one. Written apart, both go.

case:     a key beginning inside the key before it
in:       sk-ant-a-sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      «anthropic-credential»

case:     two keys separated by a space
in:       sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde sk-ant-admin01-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      «anthropic-credential» «anthropic-credential»

case:     two whole keys with nothing between them
in:       sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdesk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      «anthropic-credential»

case:     a key flush against a multi-byte rune on both sides
in:       日本語sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde日本語
out:      日本語«anthropic-credential»日本語

case:     a key in a markdown code span
in:       `sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde`
out:      `«anthropic-credential»`

case:     a key in a diff line
in:       +ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      +ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=«anthropic-credential»

# What this pattern redacts that nobody issued. The prefix is seven characters
# of an alphabet of sixty-four, so a base64url encoding long enough carries it,
# and where a kind, a hyphen and ninety-five more characters follow inside the
# same run, everything from the prefix to the end of that run is redacted. The
# two hyphens in the prefix narrow this further than it looks — standard base64
# writes no hyphen at all, so a certificate or an embedded image holds no prefix
# to be found at however long it runs.
#
# That is the answer rather than a fault in it: what is taken is a stretch of a
# value already opaque to a reader, and the tightening on offer is a table of
# the names a kind writes, which would have located nothing on the day sid02 was
# added beside sid01. A stale list costs a whole credential, and this costs a
# reader nothing. The pattern's own file weighs both.

case:     the prefix and a long enough run inside a base64url payload
in:       payload=zzzzsk-ant-a-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdezzzz
out:      payload=zzzz«anthropic-credential»

case:     the prefix and a long enough run where a signature stands
in:       eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.zzzzsk-ant-a-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdezzzz
out:      eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhYmMifQ.zzzz«anthropic-credential»

# And what this pattern leaves alone. The first three are the prefix: read in
# its own case, in all seven of its characters, and asked for at all. Of the
# last three, the digest carries no hyphen and so holds no prefix to be found
# at; no word of prose is spelled sk-ant-; and the hyphenated identifier is the
# one that carries the prefix and is turned away by nothing but the count — a
# task-ant- holds sk-ant- three characters in, and what stands behind it is a
# phrase rather than ninety-five unbroken characters of the alphabet.

case:     an uppercase prefix
in:       SK-ANT-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      SK-ANT-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde

case:     an underscore where the prefix carries a hyphen
in:       sk_ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      sk_ant-api03-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde

case:     a run of the right length opening with no prefix
in:       0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde

case:     a hexadecimal digest
in:       sha1=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      sha1=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

case:     prose
in:       there is no credential in this sentence
out:      there is no credential in this sentence

case:     a hyphenated identifier carrying the prefix
in:       the task-ant-colony-optimization-benchmark-suite was reviewed
out:      the task-ant-colony-optimization-benchmark-suite was reviewed
